import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from kt import *

FAIL = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

def campaign(types, modules, runs, calls=None, pipes=None, entries=None, machine=None):
    return {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls or [],
            "pipes": pipes or [], "entries": entries or ["main"],
            "machine": machine, "runs": runs}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- strings
types = [{"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3},
         {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
mods = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S"]], "result": ["r", "S"], "requires": None}]
runs = [
    {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest([("x1", b"a"), ("x2", b"\x00"), ("x3", b"b"),
                                   ("x5", b"z"), ("x6", b"\x00"), ("x7", b"\x00")])},
    {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest([("x1", b"q"), ("x2", b"r"), ("x3", b"s"),
                                   ("x5", b"z"), ("x6", b"\x00"), ("x7", b"\x00")])},
    {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest([("x1", b""), ("x2", b""), ("x3", b""),
                                   ("x5", b""), ("x6", b""), ("x7", b"")])},
]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs, entries=["m"]))
check("string plan slots", out['plans'][0]['slots'],
      [["x1", ["s", 0], 1], ["x2", ["s", 1], 1], ["x3", ["s", 2], 1],
       ["x5", ["r", 0], 1], ["x6", ["r", 1], 1], ["x7", ["r", 2], 1]])
check("string variables", out['plans'][0]['variables'], 8)
check("string corpus", out['corpus'],
      [{"entry": "m", "inputs": {"s": "a"}, "cost": 0, "commands": [], "witnesses": [0]},
       {"entry": "m", "inputs": {"s": "qrs"}, "cost": 0, "commands": [], "witnesses": [1]},
       {"entry": "m", "inputs": {"s": ""}, "cost": 0, "commands": [], "witnesses": [2]}])
check("string model result", out['records'][0]['model_result'], "z")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pipes
types = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32}, {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None},
        {"name": "filt", "params": [["v", "N"]], "result": ["fr", "Flag"],
         "requires": ["gt", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N", 10]]}]
def mainrun(value, flag):
    return {"entry": "main",
            "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(value, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01"),
                            ("x2", b"\x00" if flag == 0 else b"\x01")])}
runs = [mainrun(5, 1), mainrun(50, 0), mainrun(5, 0), mainrun(50, 1)]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs,
                   pipes=[{"target": "main", "filter": "filt", "bind": {"v": "n"}}]))
check("pipe plan modules", out['plans'][0]['modules'], ["filt", "main"])
check("pipe flag", out['plans'][0]['flag'], "x2")
check("pipe variables", out['plans'][0]['variables'], 3)
check("pipe records", [r['status'] for r in out['records']],
      ["FILTERED", "READY", "INVALID_TEST", "INVALID_TEST"])

# ------------------------------------------------- transitive nested pipe
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None},
        {"name": "f1", "params": [["v", "N"]], "result": ["fr", "Flag"],
         "requires": ["gt", ["var", "v"], ["const", "N", 10]]},
        {"name": "f2", "params": [["w", "N"]], "result": ["fr", "Flag"],
         "requires": ["lt", ["var", "w"], ["const", "N", 100]]}]
runs = [mainrun(50, 0), mainrun(5, 1), mainrun(500, 1)]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs,
                   pipes=[{"target": "main", "filter": "f1", "bind": {"v": "n"}},
                          {"target": "f1", "filter": "f2", "bind": {"w": "v"}}]))
check("nested pipe modules", out['plans'][0]['modules'], ["f2", "f1", "main"])
check("nested pipe records", [r['status'] for r in out['records']],
      ["READY", "FILTERED", "FILTERED"])

# ------------------------------------------------------- entry predicate
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
         "requires": ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 3]]}]
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])}]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs))
check("entry predicate accepts", out['records'][0]['status'], "READY")
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(4, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])}]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, runs))
check("entry predicate rejects", out['records'][0]['status'], "FILTERED")

# ------------------------------------------------------------- invalid tests
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}]
cases = {
    "bad base64": {"entry": "main", "ktest": "!!!!not base64!!"},
    "missing object": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4))])},
    "extra object": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01"), ("x7", b"\x00")])},
    "duplicate object": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
    "wrong width": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 2)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
    "trailing bytes": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")], trailing=b"\x00")},
    "bad version": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")], version=2)},
    "leading zero name": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x00", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
    "bool out of range": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x02")])},
    "int padding bits": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(1 << 20, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
    "empty payload": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ""},
    "name without digits": {"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x", u(3, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
}
for name, run_spec in cases.items():
    out = run(campaign(types, mods, [run_spec]))
    check("invalid: " + name, out['records'][0]['status'], "INVALID_TEST")

# ------------------------------------------------- invalid takes precedence
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
         "requires": ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 3]]}]
out = run(campaign(types, mods, [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(9, 4))])}]))
check("transport beats filtering", out['records'][0]['status'], "INVALID_TEST")

print()
print("FAILURES:", FAIL if FAIL else "none")
PYEOF
